name: Mothdude
source:
Mothdude follows a group a middle school friends who end up finding more than they bargained for while searching for the perfect place to skate.

[From [url=https://featherboy.itch.io/mothdude]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Mothdude》讲述一群初中生朋友的故事。他们原本在寻找最适合滑板的地方，却发现了远超预期的东西。

[来源：[url=https://featherboy.itch.io/mothdude]Itch.io[/url]]
